mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold activation.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment below 150,000 thousand and rise in unemployment rate above 3.5% signals severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both conditions hold, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines, or Rank IC for HOUST < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 (index 2017=100) indicates contraction in manufacturing and industrial output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts indicates robust consumer demand for housing, supporting economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 60-day return when HOUST > 1700 is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate below 1.0% and high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 290) signals aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both conditions hold, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 670,000 (thousands of dollars) signals weakening consumer spending, leading to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 670000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
